title: Our Ethics and Compliance Programme
gist: Glencore's web overview of its Ethics and Compliance Programme: a risk-based, feedback-loop framework built with external counsel and DOJ/UK MoJ/Swiss guidance. Descriptive and promotional, with no quantitative outcomes.

insights.claim: Glencore's Ethics and Compliance Programme comprises risk assessments, policies, standards, procedures and guidelines, training and awareness, advice, monitoring, speaking openly and raising concerns, investigations, and discipline and incentives.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Baseline checklist for judging whether Glencore's compliance framework is complete versus peers.

insights.claim: Glencore describes its programme as risk-based, built to address the challenges of its diverse business operations.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Risk-based framing implies resources are targeted at higher-risk activities such as trading and deals; watch where incidents still occur.
insights.quote: The key elements of our Ethics and Compliance Programme establish a risk-based approach to ethics and compliance

insights.claim: Glencore says the programme elements form a feedback loop intended to identify and address compliance risks across the business on an ongoing basis.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Claimed continuous improvement; test against disclosed remediation and monitoring results.
insights.quote: Together, the elements create a feedback loop

insights.claim: Glencore states the programme was designed with external counsel and other advisors, having regard to guidance from the US Department of Justice, the UK Ministry of Justice and Switzerland's State Secretariat for Economic Affairs.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Aligning with DOJ, UK and Swiss guidance signals a design aimed at satisfying the regulators that oversee Glencore's past and present exposures; relevant to enforcement and monitorship risk.

insights.claim: Glencore says dedicated compliance IT systems, data analytics and controls embedded in business systems support the programme.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Tech-enabled monitoring should improve detection; investors can look for evidence in disclosed screening and analytics outcomes.

insights.claim: Glencore highlights automation of vessel screening as a programme-in-action example, implying sanctions and counterparty risk on shipping is a focus for its commodity trading.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Shipping and sanctions compliance is a key risk for commodity traders; monitor for related enforcement news.

insights.claim: Glencore provides safe channels to raise concerns of potential misconduct through its Raising Concerns Programme, with investigations coordinated to be objective and consistent, confidential, and protective against retaliation.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Whistleblower channel quality is a leading indicator of misconduct detection; watch reported case volumes.

insights.claim: Glencore lists a refreshed Code of Conduct townhall, deal lifecycle training and a Social Contribution Framework launch as recent programme activities.
insights.speaker: Glencore investor reports
insights.so_what: Shows activity but no outcome data; treat as soft evidence of programme maturity.
